# Drifter — Bihar's Premier Outdoor Adventure Community

> Drifter is a modern, community-first outdoor adventure brand based in Patna, Bihar (operated by Trevmonk Travelsolution Pvt Ltd). We organize curated backpacking drops, wilderness pine forest camping, Himalayan treks, and offbeat travel experiences for young explorers starting from Patna.

## Core Information
- **Brand Name**: Drifter
- **Legal Entity**: Trevmonk Travelsolution Pvt Ltd
- **Basecamp Location**: Maurya Lok Complex, Patna, Bihar, India
- **Website**: https://www.drifter.buzz
- **Helpline / WhatsApp**: +91 7978578168
- **Instagram**: https://www.instagram.com/thedrifter.club/ (@thedrifter.club)

## Brand Philosophy & Manifesto
Drifter is not a commercial travel agency selling generic tour packages. We are a private, curated outdoor community prioritizing safety, genuine connection, and unscripted adventures. Our philosophy:
- Strangers at 6 AM, homies by sundown.
- No rigid minute-by-minute commercial tour packages.
- Leave no trace: zero plastic left in the wilderness.
- Curated groups: fit, active, and hungry for real stories.

## Live Expeditions & Drops
- [Pokhara Party × Secret Trek](https://www.drifter.buzz/expeditions/pokhara-party-secret-trek): 4 Days / 3 Nights contrast drop in Nepal combining lakeshore nightlife in Pokhara with an offbeat secret mountain ridge trek. Starting Price: ₹10,998.
- [Netarhat Pine Forest Camping](https://www.drifter.buzz/expeditions/netarhat-camping): 2 Days / 1 Night weekend getaway into Chotanagpur pine forests, campfire BBQ, Ghaghri waterfall hike, and Magnolia Point sunrise. Starting Price: ₹4,499.

## Upcoming Expeditions
- **Rohtasgarh Fort × Cliffside Camping**: Camping inside 16th-century historic fort ruins on the Kaimur limestone plateau overlooking the Son river.
- **Kasol Party × Parvati Valley Trekking**: Backpacking Parvati Valley, Tosh villages, and artisanal mountain cafes.
- **Sojha Secret Village**: Quiet pine forest reset in Tirthan Valley, Himachal Pradesh.
- **Sandakphu Singalila Ridge**: Kanchenjunga & Everest panoramic ridge trek.

## Comprehensive Travel Guides for Bihar Explorers
- [10 Best Weekend Trips from Patna for 2026](https://www.drifter.buzz/stories/10-best-weekend-trips-from-patna): Complete guide covering Netarhat, Rajgir, Rohtasgarh, Varanasi, Bodhgaya, Deoghar, Pokhara, Darjeeling, Kakolat, and Valmiki Tiger Reserve.
- [Nepal Trip from Patna: Complete Budget Guide](https://www.drifter.buzz/stories/nepal-trip-from-patna): Raxaul border crossing, Kathmandu vs Pokhara, Tata Sumo transport, Voter ID documentation, and budgets.
- [Patna to Kasol: Backpacking Guide](https://www.drifter.buzz/stories/patna-to-kasol): Express train routes via Delhi/Chandigarh, Bhuntar bus transfers, Tosh village treks, cafes, and budgets.
- [Patna to Jibhi: Offbeat Himachal Guide](https://www.drifter.buzz/stories/patna-to-jibhi): Aut tunnel transit, Jalori Pass, Serolsar Lake, Shoja wooden stays, and quiet mountain villages.
- [Patna to Meghalaya: Complete Backpacking Guide](https://www.drifter.buzz/stories/patna-to-meghalaya): Guwahati transit, Sohra plunge waterfalls, Nongriat 3,000-step double-decker root bridge trek, and Shnongpdeng crystal river camping.
